name: Accounting core
history: Core journal and source history is always available to authorized readers. 1.2 adds users, roles and capabilities: authorisation is pl_user_can() over a capability catalogue, the three protected system roles are installation-wide definitions assigned per company, and the 1.1 role ENUM on pl_company_members stays mirrored through 1.2 and is dropped in 1.3. 1.2.1 lets a new business start from a sample company's structure: the structure section is read separately from the sample's history, the import posts nothing and leaves every balance at zero, and pl_sample_imports records which structure produced which business. 1.2.1 adds the plugin runtime: packages are recorded in pl_packages with an immutable pl_package_actions audit, their own migration receipts and one shared options table, and only an installation administrator installs or activates one.
